snippet.title: Orbstack Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Just a short video showing a little bit of Orbstack, the game I am currently working on. It is a Stacklands inspired game where you ponder the Orb, collect resources, gather allies and cast spells to stop the demons.

You can wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122180/Orbstack/
You can also find it on Itch: https://jesus-rugarcia.itch.io/orbstack
